{{Expand|document the mentions in the rest of the listed sources}}
{{Quote|To say that the Force works in mysterious ways is to admit one's ignorance, for any mystery can be solved through the application of knowledge and unrelenting effort.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>}}
"'''The Force works in mysterious ways''',"<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref> also existing as the variation "'''the Force moves in mysterious ways'''," was a phrase<ref name="Soldier">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref> that concerned the energy field known as [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="CSWE Force">{{CSWECite|I|285|Force, the}}</ref> [[Larin Moxla]],<ref name="FatalAlliance">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref> [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]],<ref name="DP" /> [[I-5YQ]],<ref name="TLJ" /> [[Jan Ors]],<ref name="Soldier" /> [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="Fight">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref> and [[Kinnin Vo-Shay]]<ref name="Journal13">{{JournalCite|13|The Last Hand (short story)}}</ref> at various points all used the phrase<ref name="TLJ" /> or a variation of it.<ref name="Soldier" /> In addition, [[Marcus Trant]],<ref name="Annihilation">''[[The Old Republic: Annihilation]]''</ref> [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]],<ref name="DoE">''[[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil]]''</ref> [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]],<ref name="MedStar">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref> and [[Zekk]]<ref name="Delusions">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Delusions of Grandeur]]''</ref> also noted the phrase<ref name="MedStar" /> or its variations mentally.<ref name="Delusions" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DarkForces-SoldierForTheEmpire.jpg|thumb|right|250px|''Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire'' introduced the first version of the phrase "the Force works in mysterious ways."]]
The phrase "the Force works in mysterious ways"<ref name="TLJ" /> originated as "the Force moves in mysterious ways" in [[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire|''Soldier for the Empire'']], the [[1997]] first entry in the [[Star Wars: Dark Forces (novellas)|''Star Wars: Dark Forces'']] series of novellas by [[William C. Dietz]].<ref name="Soldier" /> A variation of the phrase, "the Jedi work in mysterious ways," debuted in [[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice|''The Fight for Justice'']], [[John Peel]]'s [[1998]] first installment of the ''[[Star Wars Journal]]'' series of young reader novels.<ref name="Fight" />

[[Michael Reaves]] and [[Steve Perry]]'s [[2004]] novel [[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons|''Battle Surgeons'']], the first novel of the [[MedStar Duology]], introduced "the Force does work in mysterious ways,"<ref name="MedStar" /> and the novel [[Darth Bane: Dynasty of Evil|''Dynasty of Evil'']], [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2009]] final entry of the ''[[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy]]'', debuted the unemphasized version of the phrase, "the Force worked in mysterious ways."<ref name="DoE" /> [[James Luceno]]'s [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']] marked the first time that an [[in-universe]] character used that baseline phrasing in direct speech.<ref name="DP" /> The [[2015]] sourcebook ''[[Keeping the Peace]]'', a supplement for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' system of [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying]] products, introduced yet another variant of the phrase, "the Force operates in mysterious ways."<ref name="Keeping">''[[Keeping the Peace]]''</ref>

Prior to the introduction of the phrase into ''[[Star Wars]]'' in in-universe context, [[Michael P. Kube-McDowell]] humorously noted in the acknowledgments section of ''[[Tyrant's Test]]'', the [[1996]] final entry of ''[[The Black Fleet Crisis]]'' novel series, that [https://web.archive.org/web/20251018115503/https://literaryagencies.com/scovil-galen-ghosh-literary-agency/ Scovil Chichak Galen Literary Agency] agent Russ Galen, [[Wikipedia:Bantam Books|Bantam Books]] editor [[Tom Dupree]], [[Wikipedia:Doubleday (publisher)|Bantham Doubleday Dell]] audio producer Lynn Bailey, and [[Lucasfilm]]<ref name="Tyrant">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> editor<ref name="Rostoni">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/rostoni_retirement/index.html|text=Sue Rostoni to Retire as ''Star Wars'' Editor}}</ref> [[Sue Rostoni]] all worked "their mysterious ways through such arcane media as the fax, the telephone, and E-mail" while assisting with the publication process of the trilogy.<ref name="Tyrant" /> The phrase "the Force works in mysterious ways" shares similarities with the real-world proverb "God moves in mysterious ways," which originated from [[Wikipedia:William Cowper|William Cowper]]'s 18th-century [[Wikipedia:Hymn|hymn]] "[[Wikipedia:God Moves in a Mysterious Way|Light Shining out of Darkness]]."<ref name="Proverbs">{{BookCite|author=Mansen, Martin H.|title=The Facts on File Dictionary of Proverbs|version=Second Edition|publisher=[[Wikipedia:Infobase|Facts On File]]|date=2007|pages=p. 103|link=https://books.google.lv/books?id=fgaUQc8NbTYC&pg=PA103&redir_esc=y#v=onepage&q&f=false}}</ref>
